openhpi_user.description: System user account under which the openhpid daemon will run (for security hardening).

openhpi_group.description: System group for the openhpid daemon process.

openhpi_pidfile.description: Full path to the PID file where the daemon writes its process ID.

openhpi_loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging. Set to DEBUG for detailed diagnostics, ERROR or higher for minimal output.

openhpi_logfile.description: Path to the primary log file. Use '-' to log to stderr (e.g., when using systemd journal).

openhpi_log_rotation_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep when log rotation is enabled.

openhpi_log_rotation_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a log file before it is rotated.

openhpi_transport_plugins.description: List of transport plugins to enable (e.g., IPMI, SNMP, Redfish). Each entry configures one plugin with its options.

options.description: Plugin-specific key-value configuration options (e.g., timeouts, retry counts, device paths).

openhpi_auto_load_resources.description: If true, automatically load discovered hardware resources into the HPI inventory.

openhpi_scan_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic scans for new or changed resources. Set to 0 to disable periodic scanning.

openhpi_snmp_discovery.description: Configuration for SNMP-based auto-discovery of hardware resources.

community.description: SNMP community string used for discovery queries.

subnets.description: List of IPv4/IPv6 subnets (CIDR or dotted notation) to scan for SNMP-managed devices.
List of subnets to scan for IPMI-capable BMCs.

ssl_verify.description: If true, validate TLS certificates when connecting to Redfish endpoints.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for Redfish API calls.

hosts.description: List of specific Redfish hosts/URLs to probe (e.g., 'https://bmc1.example.com').

openhpi_max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent HPI sessions allowed system-wide.

openhpi_max_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum number of HPI sessions any single user may hold simultaneously.

openhpi_session_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for HPI sessions. A value of 0 disables session timeouts.
